title: 🌤️ The sky becomes a promise.
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly…
I keep to the edge of the moment. Hidden behind stone and reed. The air still heavy with rain. The ark rests in silence — wood darkened by obedience and endurance.
Light presses through retreating clouds… warm against the cool breath of the storm. And there it is — color stretched across the heavens. Not loud. Not theatrical. Just steady.
A bow placed in the sky.
Not drawn in wrath… but set down in mercy.
I do not step forward. I simply witness. The covenant is spoken, but the rainbow speaks without words. Judgment has passed. Grace remains.

If God writes His promises in light…
How often do I pause long enough to see them?
